summary: Delegated access approval stuck after manager transfer blocks console feature-flag access
description: Issue summary: Developer requested delegated Admin access to feature-flag control path via internal Console. After a recent manager change (manager transfer in HR system), the approval workflow for the delegated access request did not progress and remains 'Pending approval' with no visible approver. Impact: Jordan Li cannot toggle feature flags required for a hotfix rollout; rollout blocked and product owner escalated.
impact: Single developer blocked from performing urgent feature-flag rollback; potential customer-facing risk if hotfix is not rolled out in next 2 hours.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) User (jordan.li@redwood.ai) initiates 'Request Delegated Access' from Console -> Access Requests -> Request role 'FeatureFlagAdmin' for 4 hours.
2) Request lands in approval service and shows status 'Pending approval'. No approver listed in UI.
3) Approver notifications are not delivered; approval queue does not populate for manager (new-manager@example.com).
4) Verify SCIM user record for Jordan shows updated manager attribute pointing to new manager id.
5) Observe approval service logs for evaluation of approver mapping (see logs).
logs: 2026-03-12T09:14:21Z APPROVAL-SVC ERROR approver_resolution failed: approver_not_found userId=usr_94821 requestId=req_77e5
2026-03-12T09:14:25Z SCIM-SYNC INFO processed PATCH /Users/usr_94821 {manager: mgr_55012} status=200
2026-03-12T09:15:03Z NOTIF-WORKER WARN delivery-failed: no-recipient found for approverId=mgr_55012 requestId=req_77e5
2026-03-12T09:20:41Z APPROVAL-SVC INFO cache-hit approver_map:user:usr_94821 -> mgr_42001 (stale entry)
2026-03-12T09:21:02Z QUEUE-SVC INFO retry-scheduled requestId=req_77e5 attempt=1 reason=approver_resolution_failed
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: SCIM pushed manager update but approval service is resolving approver from an internal cache that still referenced the old manager (mgr_42001).
Observed that SCIM PATCH was accepted by SCIM-SYNC and Okta system logs show manager attribute change concurrently (see related_confluence_pages).
Approval service cache TTL currently set to 24h; cache contains stale mapping for usr_94821 -> mgr_42001 despite successful SCIM update.
Notification worker attempted to deliver and failed because approverId mgr_55012 did not exist in approval-routing table at time of delivery (race window between SCIM push and routing table rebuild).
No 5xx from Okta API; failures localized to in-house approval-routing logic and cache invalidation path.
root_cause_summary: Race condition: manager attribute update (SCIM) was processed, but approval-routing service relied on a stale in-memory cache and did not observe the change. The approval job continued to reference the old approver id and then failed to reconcile with the new manager entry, leaving the request pending.
temporary_mitigation: Manually invalidated approval-service cache for affected user (usr_94821) and re-enqueued request req_77e5. Triggered notification delivery to new-manager (new-manager@example.com). User Jordan confirmed they received email and approval completed. Documented manual steps in comment below.
long_term_fix_proposal: 1) Wire SCIM-SYNC to publish 'manager_change' event to approval-service and trigger immediate cache invalidation for affected user(s).
2) Reduce approval-service approver_map cache TTL from 24h to 5m and add eventual-consistency backoff/retry with exponential jitter for approval resolution jobs.
3) Add monitoring alert for 'pending_requests_without_approver' > X in 15m window and include request age and last SCIM-update timestamp.
4) Add end-to-end integration test that simulates SCIM manager transfer during a pending approval.
resolution: In progress - manual invalidation and requeue applied; approval completed for affected request. Awaiting platform change to close ticket.
